summary: Accelevation Holdings filed a Form 8-K covering the September 29, 2026 underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley and J.P. Morgan for its initial public offering of Class A common stock. The IPO priced at $18.00 per share, with the company selling 10,000,000 primary shares and selling stockholders offering 20,000,000 secondary shares, for a base deal size of $540 million; selling stockholders also granted a 30-day over-allotment of up to 4,500,000 shares. The company filed this as a routine current report on an ordinary IPO closing, not a special situation. The prospectus was filed under Rule 424(b) and the deal closed October 1, 2026 on Nasdaq under the ticker ACCV.
